'''S1-M0 "Doc Simon"''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] it was aboard the [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]] ''[[Brentaal Star]]'' during the [[Attack on the Brentaal Star]] by the [[Gage-class transport]] ''[[Black Talon]]''. S1-M0 was in a boarding party against that vessel, accompanied by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Boran]], [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Hattak]] and [[Private/Legends|Private]] [[Keemos]]. They defended their boarding shuttle against a counterattack by an Imperial strike team, but after were all killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
S1-M0 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the "Black Talon" flashpoint only if player choose the ''Light Side'' option during their conversation with Captain [[Revinal Orzik|Orzik]], keeping him alive.
